_about: A line's mood (Voice casting, per line): how its speaker says it. speed: times SAM's speed (higher: slower); pitch: added to SAM's pitch (lower: a higher voice); bright, breath, movement, hiss: percent of the speaker's hi-fi tuning; whisper: breath alone, no voice. A mood says its line in hi-fi. Read by the game (sound.lua) and the editor (samvoice.py).
